subject: Consolidating two pilots — packaging and discount options
messages:
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@bluepeak.com>

Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidating two pilot contracts — packaging and discount options

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demos last week. We are running two separate pilots right now (SearchAssist and SupportGen) and procurement is asking whether we can consolidate under a single contract / plan to simplify billing and reduce duplication of retained data and observability costs. A few constraints from my side:

- We need predictable monthly unit economics for budgeting (prefer some committed component).
- Legal wants the ability to step down capacity after the pilot period if usage is lower than expected (within reason).
- We want both products to have dedicated throughput when needed (SearchAssist is bursty; SupportGen is steady).

Can you outline the packaging options you recommend (hosted vs dedicated vs hybrid), what features would be bundled (console retention, premium support, Optimize credits), and what discount bands are typical for a consolidated, multi-product commitment? Please attach an indicative quote so I can run it by procurement.

I’ve attached the current POs for both pilots.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that’s easier.

Sofia Martinez
Sr. Product Ops, BluePeak Systems
sofia.m@bluepeak.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Consolidating two pilot contracts — packaging and discount options

Sofia —

Appreciate the clear constraints. High-level options below (short bullet format so procurement can scan):

1) Single Dedicated pool (recommended for predictability)
   - One dedicated GPU pool reserved for BluePeak, logically partitioned into two projects for SearchAssist and SupportGen.
   - Bundled: Redwood Console (90-day trace/retention), Redwood Optimize Lite (batching/caching suggestions), 24x5 support.
   - Pricing model: committed monthly throughput + overage at published unit rates.
   - Discount guidance: 12–18% on list depending on commit length (12–36 months) and payment terms.
   - Step-down: allow 1 planned step-down per 12-month period with 60-day notice + re-baselining.

2) Hybrid (Dedicated baseline + Hosted burst)
   - Dedicated capacity sized for average steady usage; hosted API for spikes.
   - Bundled observability as above; additional per-spike usage invoiced at hosted rates (no discount on burst).

3) Hosted consolidated account (fastest, less predictability)
   - Single billing account, add Console & Optimize as add-ons.
   - Discount bands smaller (5–10%), but lower operational overhead.

I’ve attached an initial pricing workbook with a few sample commit tiers and indicative monthly charges (Consolidated_PRICING_v1.xlsx). Key things to confirm from your side so we can firm up numbers: expected steady tokens/day for each service, desired commit term (6/12/24/36), and any internal billing requirements (PO cadence).

If you’re targeting a single-contract approach with a 12-month commit, I can propose a formal quote with a one-time consolidation credit. If procurement needs an explicit downgrade path, we typically model a financial step-down (e.g., reduced commitment tier but prorated reconciliation) rather than immediate fleet deprovisioning — happy to include a protective clause for you.

Happy to run through the workbook together. Are you available Monday morning PT for 30 minutes?

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer

Sofia —

Looping in a couple of commercial details from our side to make procurement’s review faster. Picking up Karthik’s options:

- If BluePeak commits to a 12-month annualized reserved pool we can offer an 18% net discount on list (applies to on-going committed spend). To qualify: consolidated SOW + single PO for the committed amount.
- Alternative: 6-month commit gets 12% discount; month-to-month consolidation gets 7–8% discount on bundled lines (no commitment).
- Consolidation credit: one-time credit equal to 1 month of committed spend if both pilots sign into the single contract within 30 days of quote acceptance.

Operational items to confirm:
- Console retention tiers: 90 days included, 180 days available for an additional fixed fee per month.
- Support: standard 24x5 included; 24x7 and premium SLA add-on priced separately.
- Migration: we provide an operational migration runbook and up to 8 hours of onboarding assistance included in the consolidation credit.

We can also include a 2% overage protection credit (applied monthly) if you predefine an overage buffer band — this helps procurement with budgeting.

If that sounds reasonable, we’ll prepare:
- Final quote with line-items (to route to legal/procurement)
- SOW draft for your legal team

Karthik — I’m available Monday 9:30–11:30 PT to joint-call with Sofia and procurement.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
